title: Goodwill credits
issue: Support can grant goodwill credits to unhappy customers. Add `goodwill_credit(invoice, amount, reason)` to `ledgerly/adjustments.py`: it credits `amount` against an issued invoice and returns a dict with the keys `invoice_id`, `amount` and `reason`. The amount must be positive and must not exceed the invoice total, and only issued invoices can be credited.
